2342-4590-7070.notablePrerequisites: You have attacked 2 or more opponents this turn.
2342-4590-7070.description:
Activate Shaman en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting itself.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Shaman en-Kor.
The Shaman en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Shaman en-Kor from exile by paying {0} due to Commander Liara Portyr.
Repeat.

728-1636-4147-4215.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional nontoken green creature.
Hua Tuo does not have summoning sickness.
728-1636-4147-4215.description:
During your precombat main phase, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the additional nontoken green creature.
When the creature dies, Verdant Succession triggers.
Holding priority, activate Hua Tuo by tapping it, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Verdant Succession trigger, searching your library for the sacrificed creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability from step 1, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

5742-5743-7435-7824.description:
Activate Hardened Academic by discarding Gilded Assault Cart.
Mary Read and Anne Bonny triggers, creating two tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Hardened Academic ability.
Activate Gilded Assault Cart by sacrificing two Treasures, returning Gilded Assault Cart from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

215-5614-7730.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
215-5614-7730.description:
Activate Bighorner Rancher by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Bighorner Rancher from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Bighorner Rancher by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-4605-5542-6152.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4605-5542-6152.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Veteran Dungeoneer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Veteran Dungeoneer enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Veteran Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Veteran Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first Veteran Dungeoneer token trigger, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the second Veteran Dungeoneer token trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice the nontoken Veteran Dungeoneer.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Veteran Dungeoneer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Veteran Dungeoneer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first Veteran Dungeoneer token trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-2642-4050-7443.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one card in your graveyard.
1170-2642-4050-7443.description:
Cast a copy of the prepared spell by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten and Dovescape trigger.
Resolve the Dovescape trigger, countering the prepared spell and creating a number of 1/1 flying Bird creature tokens equal to its mana value.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten trigger, blinking Emeritus of Abundance // Regrowth, which enters prepared.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Bird token, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat step 5 until you have enough mana to cast the prepared spell.
Repeat.

2440-4742-7108-7109.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-4742-7108-7109.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

3053-4067-6281-7252.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
3053-4067-6281-7252.description:
Activate Prismatic Geoscope by tapping it, adding at least {U}{U}{U}.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Grave Sifter.
Hashaton triggers, causing you to pay {2}{U} to create a tapped token copy of Grave Sifter that is a 4/4 Zombie.
When the Grave Sifter token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Grave Sifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Prismatic Geoscope.
Repeat.

140-2421-3705-4050.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it, causing black and red spells you cast to cost {1} less for each life you've lost this turn.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Squee and Skyfire Phoenix, adding {R}{R}.
Cast Squee from your graveyard by paying {R}{R}.
Skyfire Phoenix triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2

3490-4050-4369-5719.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature with power 1 or greater to enter the battlefield under your control.
3490-4050-4369-5719.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
Molten Gatekeeper triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
The Red Terror triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on itself.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Molten Gatekeeper triggers.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the Molten Gatekeeper triggers, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Repeat from step 3.

112-957-6496.manaNeeded: {14}{U}{U}{U}{U} the first turn with {9}{U}{U}{U} each other turn
112-957-6496.easyPrerequisites: You've cast exactly one spell this turn.
112-957-6496.description:
Cast Time Stretch by paying its mana cost.
Taigam triggers, copying Time Stretch and exiling the original Time Stretch with four time counters on it.
Resolve the Time Stretch copy, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Stretch and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Repeat step 4 one additional time.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Time Stretch's suspend ability triggers, removing a time counter from it.
Cast Clockspinning with buyback by paying {3}{U}, removing a time counter from Time Stretch and returning Clockspinning to your hand.
Time Stretch's suspend ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.
112-957-6496.notes: You can use Clockspinning as a way to cast a spell before starting the combo if needed. Since you need to ensure Time Stretch is always the second spell cast each extra turn after Clockspinning, it is recommended to not have any other suspended cards when beginning the combo. Otherwise, you can ensure Time Stretch is second by casting Clockspinning with the other suspend abilities on the stack during your upkeep.

483-2292-5170-6132.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Cruel Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

104-2034-3490-4210.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2034-3490-4210.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Pious Evangel triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Regardless, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
When the Servo dies, Wayward Disciple triggers if it's on the battlefield.
Resolve either the Pious Evangel or Wayward Disciple trigger, causing you to gain life and target opponent to lose 1 life if Wayward Disciple triggered.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Forensic Researcher and without summoning sickness

5329-5475-6913.description:
Activate Forensic Researcher by tapping it, targeting Chameleon.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Forensic Researcher ability, untapping Chameleon.
Activate Chameleon by tapping it, targeting Forensic Researcher.
Deeproot Pilgrimage triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve the Chameleon ability, untapping Forensic Researcher.
Repeat.

586-864-2701-5626.easyPrerequisites: You have at least three energy counters.
586-864-2701-5626.description:
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Eternal Witness and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}, sacrificing Priest of Gix and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning Eternal Witness from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Eternal Witness enters, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Repeat.

339-677-4927-5231.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2167-2366-3234-5626.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four mana-producing lands except Dryad Arbor, two of which can tap to produce at least {B}
2167-2366-3234-5626.description:
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a land, adding one mana of any color that land could produce.
Repeat step 1 until you have at least {2}{B}{B} available and/or you control no other mana-producing lands.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by sacrificing World Shaper and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, targeting Dryad Arbor.
When World Shaper dies, its second ability triggers, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
The ability from step 3 fizzles due to having no legal target, as Dryad Arbor will be returned to the battlefield by World Shaper.
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying {E}{E}{E}{E}, sacrificing Dryad Arbor and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand, returning World Shaper from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.
2167-2366-3234-5626.notes: When you sacrifice World Shaper, you can use up to {E}{E} and return another applicable creature instead of targeting Dryad Arbor and letting the ability fizzle.

122-328-2511-2732.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur twice by sacrificing Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant die, Prowling Geistcatcher's first ability triggers twice, exiling Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from your graveyard.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Prowling Geistcatcher.
When Prowling Geistcatcher dies, its second ability triggers, returning Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant from exile to the battlefield.
When Phyrexian Delver and Gray Merchant enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Gray Merchant trigger, causing each opponent to lose an amount of life equal to your devotion to black, and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Resolve the Phyrexian Delver trigger, causing you to return Prowling Geistcatcher from your graveyard to the battlefield and lose 4 life.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur abilities from steps 1 and 3.
Repeat.

539-1322-2244-4803.notablePrerequisites: You control a permanent that can tap to produce at least {W}.
539-1322-2244-4803.description:
Activate a permanent by tapping it, adding at least {W}.
Activate Nimbleclaw Adept by tapping it, untapping Ruin Ghost and the permanent.
Activate Ruin Ghost by paying {W} and tapping it, blinking Nimbleclaw Adept.
Repeat.

1479-1659-3257.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-1659-3257.description:
Play Rakdos Carnarium.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it, Seed the Land, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Rakdos Carnarium trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Seed the Land trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Rakdos Carnarium enters the battlefield, it and Seed the Land trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1242-1323-2872-3143.notablePrerequisites:
Experiment Kraj and Xavier Sal do not have summoning sickness.
Cinderhaze Wretch and Clever Conjurer each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
You control at least one creature token.
1242-1323-2872-3143.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Cinderhaze Wretch's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Activate Xavier Sal's first ability by tapping it and removing a -1/-1 counter from Experiment Kraj, creating a copy of any creature token you control.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Clever Conjurer's ability by tapping it, untapping Xavier Sal.
Repeat.

57-2178-4813-5256.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent has lost life this turn.
Thornbite Staff attached to Feldon.
Feldon does not have summoning sickness.
57-2178-4813-5256.description:
Activate Feldon by paying {2}{R} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Famished Foragers that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When Famished Foragers enters the battlefield, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Famished Foragers.
When Famished Foragers dies, Feldon triggers, untapping Feldon.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Famished Foragers' power.
Repeat.

1149-1506-3238.notablePrerequisites:
Phyrexian Colossus does not have summoning sickness.
Shadowspear and Burning Anger attached to Phyrexian Colossus.
1149-1506-3238.description:
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by tapping it, dealing 9 damage to any target and causing you to gain nine life.
Activate Phyrexian Colossus by paying eight life, untapping it.
Repeat.

456-2440-2871-2972.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {3}{R}.
Manaform Hellkite triggers, creating a 5/5 Dragon Illusion creature token with haste.
The Dragon Illusion enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Ganax.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Ganax trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Seething Anger, causing target creature to get +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

154-1563-4231-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Fierce Witchstalker.
Fierce Witchstalker enters the battlefield, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Activate the Food, Clue and Treasure tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

3944-4316-5220.description:
Activate Blood Pet by sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Mortuary triggers, putting Blood Pet on top of your library.
Cast Blood Pet for {B}.
Repeat.
